common.tagline: Online appointment booking for clinics, salons and studios.

home.title: Online appointment booking
home.description: A booking platform where customers book appointments from your own page, and each provider keeps their own working hours — with the services, people and locations of one organization kept entirely separate from every other.
home.phaseNotice: Phase 2 — providers, services and locations. The booking flow arrives in Epic 4.

invitation.signInFirst: Sign in with the address this invitation was sent to, then open the link again.
invitation.genericError: This invitation link is not valid.
invitation.settingUpFor: Setting up your account for {email}. Choose a password and you are done.

invitation.wrongUser: This invitation was issued to {invited}, but you are signed in as {current}.

catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.slugTakenArchivedHint: That name may belong to something you archived. Tick "Show archived" and restore it instead of creating a new one.
catalogue.slugHint: Appears in your booking links. Leave blank and we will make one from the name.
catalogue.bufferHint: Minutes reserved around the appointment. Customers never see them.
catalogue.requiresApproval: Needs approval before it is confirmed
catalogue.requiresApprovalHint: Bookings arrive as requests instead of being confirmed straight away.
catalogue.inheritHint: Leave blank to inherit. Zero is different: it means bookable up to the last second.
catalogue.advanceShort: Only the next {days, plural, one {day} other {# days}} will be bookable — customers will see almost nothing on the booking page.
catalogue.offeredByHint: Change who offers this on the Providers screen.
catalogue.assignOnCreateHint: Tick the services this provider offers. Assign, on their row, is where you change this later and set a duration or price that differs from the service's own.
catalogue.defaultLocationHint: Where this provider normally works. When they work — and at which location, for which service — is set by the provider on the Availability screen. Assign, on their row, adds further locations.
catalogue.createdButNotAssigned: The provider was created, but their services or location could not be linked. Use Assign on their row to finish.
catalogue.loadingAssignments: Loading this provider's services and locations…
catalogue.inheritsDuration: Leave blank to use the service's {count} min.
catalogue.priceOverrideNeedsBasePrice: This service has no set price, so there is nothing to override.
catalogue.addProviderHint: A provider is someone appointments are booked with. Giving them a login is a separate step.
catalogue.onlineBookingHint: Turn this off to keep them out of the public booking page while still taking bookings for them by phone.
catalogue.addServiceHint: Duration is what the customer sees; buffers are reserved around it and stay private.
catalogue.timezoneHint: Appointments here are shown in this zone. Leave blank to use the business's own.
catalogue.needServicesFirst: Create a service first. A provider is booked <link>for a service</link>, so one with nothing to offer cannot be booked at all.
catalogue.noLocationsYet: Assigning a <link>location</link> here says where this provider works. You have none yet — add one only if you see people in person; online and telephone appointments need none.
catalogue.assignHint: Use Assign on a provider to choose which services they offer and where they work. Until a provider is assigned at least one service, nobody can book them.
catalogue.noProviders: No providers yet. Add the first one below.
catalogue.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
catalogue.inviteIntro: We will email {email} a single-use link. They choose their own password — we never send one.
catalogue.inviteWhatTheyGet: Once they accept, this diary becomes theirs: they can set their working hours, add time off, and see their own bookings.
catalogue.inviteNeedsEmail: Providers without an email address cannot be invited. Add one on their record first.
catalogue.alreadyInvited: There is already a live invitation for this provider. Sending another will stop the first link from working.
catalogue.inviteLinkOnceHint: Only needed if the email does not arrive. Shown once — we store only a hash of it, so it cannot be recovered later.
catalogue.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.

availability.title: Availability
availability.workingHoursHint: Local times in the provider's zone. Add a second period to a day to leave a break in the middle.
availability.exceptionsHint: One-off closures and extra openings. These override the weekly hours.
availability.providerOffersNothing: This provider offers no services yet, so setting hours here will not produce any bookable times. Assign them a service on the <link>Providers</link> screen.
availability.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a provider yet. Ask an administrator to link it.
availability.skippedWarning: That time does not exist on that date — the clocks go forward. We will use the first time that does.
availability.ambiguousWarning: That time happens twice on that date — the clocks go back. We will use the earlier one.
availability.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
availability.affectedTitle: {count, plural, one {1 booking falls outside this schedule} other {# bookings fall outside this schedule}}
availability.affectedExplanation: These appointments still stand and still hold their slot. Saving does not cancel or move them — it only means the schedule no longer covers them.
availability.affectedNoNotice: Nobody is emailed about this. If an appointment needs to move or be cancelled, do that from the Bookings screen.
availability.notDelegated: No diaries have been delegated to you yet. A provider can hand you theirs from their own availability screen.
availability.delegatesHint: People who assist on this diary. You choose who, and what each of them may do.
availability.delegatesEmpty: Nobody manages this diary but the provider. Front-desk staff cannot see its bookings until somebody is added here.
availability.delegateNoCandidates: There is nobody left to add. Only active members whose role can hold a delegated diary appear here.
availability.delegateScopeAvailabilityHint: Set working hours and book out time off on this diary.
availability.delegateScopeBookingsHint: See, accept, reschedule and cancel this diary’s appointments.
availability.delegateRevokeConfirm: Take this diary back from {name}? They lose access on their next action.
availability.delegateFailed: That change could not be saved.
availability.delegateNeedsOneScope: A delegate needs at least one of the two. Use Revoke to remove their access entirely.
availability.delegatesHintProvider: People who assist on your diary. The organization owner decides who — ask them to change it.
availability.delegatesEmptyProvider: Nobody assists on your diary yet. Ask the organization owner if you need help managing it.
availability.delegateInviteSent: Invitation sent. If it does not arrive, this link works once:
availability.delegateInviteLinkOnce: Copy it now — it is shown only once.

integrations.title: Google Calendar
integrations.intro: Connect a Google account and this provider's confirmed appointments will appear in the calendar you choose, move when they are rescheduled, and grey out when they are cancelled.
integrations.notConfigured: Calendar sync has not been set up on this platform. Ask your administrator to configure it.
integrations.noneConnected: No Google account is connected yet.
integrations.noDiaryToConnect: Your membership is not linked to a provider diary, so there is nothing to connect a calendar to.
integrations.calendarsUnavailable: Google could not be reached just now. Please try again shortly.
integrations.repointWarning: Appointments already written to the current calendar will stay there. Only new and changed ones go to the calendar you pick.
integrations.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this Google account? Appointments already in the calendar will stay there — they are real appointments. Only new and changed ones will stop arriving.
integrations.needsReconnectDetail: Your bookings are safe. The platform is the record of your appointments; only the copy in Google Calendar has stopped updating. Reconnect to start it again.
integrations.noCalendarDetail: No calendar is selected yet, so nothing is being written to Google.
integrations.failedDetail: Calendar sync failed for {count, plural, one {# appointment} other {# appointments}}. A retry is scheduled.
integrations.syncingDetail: {count, plural, one {# appointment is} other {# appointments are}} on the way to Google.
integrations.healthyDetail: {count, plural, one {# appointment is} other {# appointments are}} in this calendar.
integrations.disconnectedDetail: This account is disconnected. Appointments already in the calendar were left there.

outcome.access_denied: You cancelled at Google, so nothing was connected.
outcome.invalid_state: That link has expired or was already used. Please start again.
outcome.session_required: Your sign-in was not recognised on the way back from Google. Please sign in and try again.
outcome.session_mismatch: That connection was started by somebody else, so it was refused. Please start again yourself.
outcome.exchange_failed: Google could not complete the connection. Please try again shortly.
outcome.missing_scope: Google was not given permission to manage your calendar events, so nothing can be written. Please connect again and accept that permission.
outcome.no_refresh_token: Google did not return the long-lived permission this needs. Please try connecting again.
outcome.provider_gone: That provider is no longer available, so the connection was not saved.
outcome.unknown: The connection did not complete. Please try again.
